clienttimers.config.title: Client Alarms
clienttimers.config.messageOnComplete.de: Show a message when an alarm or timer finishes. Completion chat includes Stop and Snooze buttons.
clienttimers.config.messageOnStart.desc: Show a message when an alarm, timer or stopwatch is started.
clienttimers.config.messageOnInfo.desc: Show messages for silence, snooze and similar actions.
clienttimers.config.messageDisplay.desc: Where completion messages appear. Start messages, info and lists always use chat. Titles and the action bar use a short 'ended' line.
clienttimers.config.dateOrder.desc: How slash dates are parsed and shown. Type am/pm for 12-hour times, otherwise 24-hour is assumed.
clienttimers.config.silentByDefault.desc: Newly started alarms and timers only show a message and do not play a sound.
clienttimers.config.autoStopAfterRings.d: Stop sounding after this many cycles. 0 means repeat forever until stopped or snoozed away.
clienttimers.config.playSounds.desc: Master switch for alarm audio. If this is off, completion messages are shown even when completion messages are disabled.
clienttimers.config.soundVolumeMode.desc: Alarm uses this mod's volume slider and still plays when Minecraft is muted. Game follows Minecraft's UI/master volume.
clienttimers.config.preset.desc: Choose a ringtone JSON file from config/clienttimers/presets.
clienttimers.config.preset.help: Add or edit JSON files in config/clienttimers/presets, then reopen this screen. Existing files are never overwritten on launch.
clienttimers.config.preview.desc: Play the selected ringtone on repeat. Stops when you leave the Sound tab or this screen.
clienttimers.button.snooze.hover: Silence currently ringing alarms for 5 minutes
clienttimers.error.notFound: Nothing with that name is running
clienttimers.error.worldScope: World scope is only available for ticks_playing and time_playing
clienttimers.error.notInWorld: this_world can only be used while you are in a world
clienttimers.error.alarmInPast: That alarm is already in the past
